# Vard — cheat sheet (complete language + tooling reference)

Vard is a declarative, statically typed UI language. Files: `*.vard`. All files in a
project share one namespace (no imports). The app root is `view App`.
Deeper topics: `vard doc design` (styling, Tailwind/M3/iOS mapping), `vard doc native`
(push, permissions, storage, back, insets, native modules), `vard doc packages`
(dependencies, registries, publishing), `vard doc std`.

## Loop
1. edit .vard  2. `vard check --fix` (applies machine fixes, prints the rest)
3. `vard run --do "ACTIONS"` (headless; prints tree / diffs)  4. `vard test`
Never guess UI state: read `tree`. Never guess sizes: run `why SEL`.

## Declarations (top level)
struct Todo { id: Int, title: String, done: Bool = false }   // fields `name: Type [= default]`
enum Filter { all, active, done }                            // values: .all .active .done
const maxItems = 50
fn total(xs: [Int]) -> Int { return xs.sum() }               // no `-> T` = returns nothing
extern fn share(text: String) -> Bool                        // native call (see Native)
extern fn load(id: Int, done: fn(Item?, String?))            // async native call: callback
extern event orderUpdated(order: Order)                      // platform -> app event
theme { brand: #7C3AED, primary: #7C3AED, font: "Inter" }   // color tokens (+ default font)
theme dark { brand: #C4B5FD }                                // dark-mode values
view Name(params) { members }

## Types
Int Float String Bool Color  [T] (list)  [String: T] (map)  T? (optional)  fn(A, B) -> R
Int converts to Float implicitly; nothing else converts. Int / Int truncates.
Literals: 42  3.5  "text {expr}"  true false nil  #RGB #RRGGBB #RRGGBBAA  [1, 2]  ["k": 1]  [:]
Escapes in strings: \n \t \" \\ \{ \}

## Views
view Card(title: String, onTap: fn() = {}, bind value: Bool, content: slot) {
  state count = 0                      // reactive mutable state (init runs once)
  state items: [Todo] = []             // annotate when the init is [] / [:] or nil
  pref darkMode = false                // state saved in platform preferences, app-wide by name
  let doubled = count * 2              // derived; recomputes automatically, read-only
  fn inc() { count += 1 }              // can read/write state
  on appear { load() }                 // handlers of events while the view is shown
  on back if count > 0 { count -= 1 }  // optional `if` = enabled only while true
  Column(gap: 8) {                     // then exactly the UI tree
    Text(title)
    content                            // a bare lowercase name inserts the `slot` param
  }
}
Params: `name: Type [= default]` read-only; `bind name: Type` two-way (caller passes a
mutable place, e.g. `Checkbox(value: todo.done)`); `name: slot` = children block.
First argument may be positional (first non-slot param); the rest are `name: value`.
Any view use also accepts outer props: width height minWidth minHeight maxWidth maxHeight
aspectRatio grow alignSelf id opacity offsetX offsetY scale (applied to the view's root).
Order inside a view: state / pref / let / fn / on members, then elements. No statements in the tree.

## UI tree
Element(args) { children }      // braces only for elements that take children
if cond { ... } else if c2 { ... } else { ... }
for t in todos by t.id { ... }  // `by` = stable unique key (always use for structs with id)
for t, i in todos by t.id { ... }  // i = index (Int)
for i in range(0, 5) { ... }

## Expressions
+ - * / %   == != < <= > >=   && || !   cond ? a : b   a ?? fallback   x! (unwrap)
"Count: {n}" (interpolation; `+` joins only String+String)   list[i]   map["k"] (T?)   s.field
.name  enum variant or color token, resolved from the expected type (prop, typed var, `x == .all`)
Lambdas: x => x.done   (a, b) => a + b   x => { stmts }   { stmts } (no params; handlers)
Handlers: `onTap: add` (fn reference) or `onTap: { count += 1 }` (block lambda)
No: self/this, ?., ++/--, ===, semicolons, imports, classes, modifier chains, `@State`, `{ x -> }`.

## Statements (fn bodies, handlers)
let x = 1 (immutable)  var y = 2 (mutable)  x = v  x += v  x -= v  map["k"] = v  map["k"] = nil (removes)
if c { } else { }   for x in list { }   return v   print(a, b) (to the log)
Builtins: range(a, b) -> [Int] (a..b-1), min(a, b), max(a, b), print(...)

## What is mutable
state, pref, bind params, var locals, fields/elements of those (`todos[i].done = true`,
`profile.name = "x"`, `counts["a"] = 1`), and the loop item of a `for` directly over state
(`for t in todos by t.id { Checkbox(value: t.done) }`). Params, let, and items of a
computed list (`for t in todos.filter(...)`) are read-only — update the state by id:
`todos.removeWhere(x => x.id == t.id)`. Values are copied, never aliased.

## Members
String: count isEmpty | trim() upper() lower() contains(s) startsWith(s) endsWith(s)
        split(sep) -> [String]  toInt() -> Int?  toFloat() -> Float?
Int: toFloat() toString() abs()     Float: toInt() round() floor() ceil() abs() fixed(digits) -> String
List: count isEmpty first last (T?) | contains(x) indexOf(x) -> Int? map(f) filter(f) find(f) -> T?
      any(f) all(f) sum() join(sep) sortedBy(key) reversed()
      in place (mutable lists only): append(x) insert(i, x) removeAt(i) remove(x) removeWhere(f) clear()
Map: count isEmpty keys ([String]) values ([T]) | contains(key) | in place: remove(key) clear()
Struct: construct `Todo(id: 1, title: "A")` (defaults may be omitted); read `t.title`.

## Built-in elements (units: dp)
Column / Row   gap align justify (Row: wrap)   flex containers; `Row(wrap: true)` flows onto lines
Grid           columns gap align             equal columns, cells fill row by row
Stack          align justify                  children overlap; z-order = source order; `grow` child fills height
Scroll         gap align                      vertical scrolling column; give it a bounded height (`grow: 1`)
Text(text)     style size weight color textAlign maxLines strike underline italic font letterSpacing lineHeight
Input          value (bind String) placeholder onSubmit onChange(fn(String)) secure keyboard size weight font color placeholderColor
Image(src)     fit tint                       project file ("assets/logo.png") or https URL
Spacer         flexible empty space (grow: 1 by default)
align (cross axis): .start .center .end .stretch (default)
justify (main axis): .start (default) .center .end .between .around .evenly
style: .display 34 .title 24 .heading 18 .body 16 (default) .label 15 bold .caption 13
weight: .thin .extraLight .light .regular .medium .semibold .bold .extraBold .black
textAlign: .start .center .end   fit: .cover .contain .fill   keyboard: .text .email .number .phone .url
Common props (all elements): width height minWidth minHeight maxWidth maxHeight aspectRatio grow
padding paddingX paddingY paddingTop paddingBottom paddingLeft paddingRight safeArea
background gradient ([Color]) gradientAngle (CSS deg, 180 = down) radius radiusTopLeft
radiusTopRight radiusBottomLeft radiusBottomRight border borderTop borderBottom borderLeft
borderRight borderColor shadow (.sm .md .lg .xl .xxl) shadowColor opacity offsetX offsetY
scale clip alignSelf onTap id role label checked enabled
safeArea: .all .top .bottom .vertical .horizontal .none (adds system bar/keyboard insets to padding)
role: .none .button .checkbox .switch .heading .link .image  (accessibility + inspection)
id: "name" → stable test handle `#name`.

## Localized text
strings { hello: "Hello, {name}", items: "{n} items" }    // default table = source language
strings ru { hello: "Привет, {name}", items: "{n} шт." }  // a translation (same keys/placeholders)
Text(t("hello", ["name": user.name]))   Text(t("items", ["n": "{count}"]))
`locale` (String global, e.g. "ru", "pt-BR") picks the table (exact, then base language, then
default). Keys and placeholders are checked at compile time (E0240, E0241; W0405 = missing
translation). Test: `locale ru` action, then `expect "Привет, Ann"`.

## Color tokens (light/dark automatically)
.background .surface .text .muted .primary .onPrimary .border .danger .success .warning .clear
Use .text/.muted on .background/.surface, .onPrimary on .primary. Custom: `theme { brand: #... }`.
Package `tailwind` (`vard add tailwind`): Tailwind palette (.slate50 … .rose950) + components (TwButton TwCard Badge Avatar Field).

## Std views (source: `vard doc std`)
Button(label, onTap: fn() = {}, kind: .filled|.tonal|.outline|.text = .filled, enabled: Bool = true)
Checkbox(bind value: Bool, label: String = "")     Switch(bind value: Bool, label: String = "")
Card { ... } (padded surface, slot)                Divider()
A design system is plain Vard views: copy std's pattern (tokens + params with enum `kind`).

## Platform (std; details: `vard doc native`)
Values (reactive, read-only): safeArea (Insets: top bottom left right) keyboardHeight backProgress
  isDark screenWidth screenHeight platform locale
Events (`on name(args) { }`): appear back appResume appPause deepLink(url)
  pushReceived(message) pushOpened(message) pushTokenChanged(token)
  `on back` takes the system back gesture (innermost enabled wins); none enabled = system back.
Permissions: permissionStatus(.camera) -> PermissionStatus; requestPermission(.notifications, s => {...})
  Permission .notifications .camera .microphone .location .photos .contacts
  PermissionStatus .notDetermined .granted .denied .blocked;  openAppSettings()
Storage: `pref x = default` (preferred) | prefGet/prefSet/prefRemove(key) | secureGet/secureSet/secureRemove (Keychain/Keystore)
Push: getPushToken(t => ...)  showNotification(title, body, data)  PushMessage { id title body data: [String: String] }
System: setColorScheme(.dark|.light|.system) openUrl(url) shareText(text) haptic(.success)
Edge-to-edge always: if no view mentions `safeArea`, the root is padded automatically.

## Native
`extern fn` / `extern event` declare the boundary; data = Int Float String Bool Color structs
enums lists maps optionals; results that arrive later = callback param `fn(T)` / `fn(T, E)`.
Headless calls are logged as `native: name(args)`; user externs answer from `mock`, or stay
pending until `resolve`/`send`. Device side: `vard bindings --kotlin` (typed base class);
SDK adapters are packages: `vard add firebase --allow native`. A missing native implementation is R0010.

## Packages (`vard doc packages`)
vard search WORDS | vard info NAME | vard add NAME[@1.4] | vard doc NAME | vard update [--major] | vard remove NAME
Dependencies live in vard.toml; their public names are visible without imports. Never guess a
name (P001 = no such package: search). Your declarations win over packages; two packages
exporting a name: `pkg.Name(...)` (E0231). Only direct deps are visible (E0232); `_x` is
package-private (E0230). P008 = needs a sensitive capability: ask the user, never bypass.
After `vard update`: `vard check --fix` applies the packages' migrations (E0234).
Package files show as `@name/file.vard` — read-only. Package externs answer headless from its [sim].

## Actions (`vard run --do`, .vtest files, MCP vard_run) — one per line or `;`
tree | layout | tap SEL | type SEL "text" | submit SEL | focus SEL | scroll SEL DY | why SEL | find SEL
state | lint | log | stats | theme light|dark | size W H | shot FILE.png [scale]
mock NAME VALUE | resolve NAME VALUE | send NAME VALUE | pending          (VALUE = JSON)
emit EVENT [ARGS] | push received|opened "T" "B" [{data}] | back [P|cancel]
insets T B [L R] | keyboard H | locale TAG | permission NAME STATUS | permission NAME answer STATUS
storage | restart (cold start keeping prefs/secure/permissions)
expect SEL|"text"   expect no "text"   expect SEL checked|unchecked|enabled|disabled|offscreen|visible
SEL: @12 (node id from `tree`) | #id | "label" (exact, then whole word, then substring)
Mutating actions print a diff: `+` added, `-` removed, `~` changed lines.
.vtest file = actions + optional header lines: @view Name  @size 390x844  @dark  @app ../path
Each run starts fresh and is deterministic: replay the whole sequence, don't keep sessions.
A real device (debug build): `vard run --device 127.0.0.1:8472 --do "tree"` (after
`adb forward tcp:8472 tcp:8472`) runs the same actions on the live app.

## Diagnostics
E01xx syntax, E02xx names/elements/props/packages, E03xx types, E04xx mutability, W warnings,
R runtime (printed as `! R0003 ... (file:line)`), L UI lints (overflow, tap size, contrast),
P packages/registries (vard.toml line + fix).
Each has file:line, the source line and `fix:` (auto-applied by --fix) or `help:`.
Unclear? `vard explain CODE`. Element/view signature: `vard doc Name`.
